aboutSection.heading: About me

block1.title: From business to codebase
block1.text: Before software, I worked where mistakes are expensive: procurement and data analysis in international trade, criminal investigation in public service, precision manufacturing in the USA and Germany. That gave me domain knowledge in finance, security, and operations that most developers only meet through tickets — I've lived the processes I now automate.

block2.title: Built for quality
block2.text: Quality is not a phase at the end — it's how I work from the first commit. Documented APIs, clear architecture, and high test coverage are my default, because software only creates value when the next person can maintain, extend, and trust it.

block3.title: What you can rely on
block3.text: I spent many years in professions where quality, precision, security, and confidentiality were non-negotiable. From them I bring what teams actually need day to day: a structured, self-reliant way of working, calm under time pressure, Lean/Kanban experience from real production lines, and clear communication in German, English, and Portuguese. Done means tested, documented, and deployed.

block4.title: Where I'm heading
block4.text: I go deeper into software engineering for one reason: I want to make complex systems simpler, safer, and more reliable. That's what I build for — software that keeps a business running on its worst day and lets it grow on its best.
